title: WindINR: Latent-State INR for Fast Local Wind Query and Correction in Complex Terrain
abstract: arXiv:2605.09511v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Many decisions in complex terrain require fast wind estimates at specific locations and heights rather than dense forecasts on fixed grids. We present WindINR, a latent-state implicit neural representation framework for continuous high-resolution local wind queries and correction using sparse observations. A latent-conditioned decoder maps terrain descriptors, a low-resolution background field, and continuous query coordinates to local wind estimates. WindINR separates reusable representation learning from sample-specific latent correction. During training, a privileged encoder infers reference latent states from high-resolution supervision, while a deployable predictor estimates initial states from inference-time inputs. Their discrepancies define a dataset-adaptive Gaussian prior over latent corrections. translated_title: WindINR：面向复杂地形快速局地风场查询与校正的潜在状态隐式神经表示
translated_abstract: 复杂地形中的许多决策需要在特定位置和高度上进行快速风场估计，而非在固定网格上进行密集预报。我们提出了WindINR，一个基于潜在状态的隐式神经表示（INR）框架，利用稀疏观测实现连续的高分辨率局地风场查询与校正。潜在条件化解码器将地形描述子、低分辨率背景场以及连续查询坐标映射为局地风场估计。WindINR将可复用的表示学习与样本特定的潜在校正分离开来。在训练过程中，特权编码器从高分辨率监督信号中推断参考潜在状态，而可部署的预测器则根据推理时的输入估计初始状态。两者之间的差异定义了潜在校正上的数据集自适应高斯先验。在推理阶段，网络权重保持固定，仅通过融入正则化目标的优化来更新潜在状态……
tldr: WindINR提出了一种潜在状态隐式神经表示框架，将可复用的表示学习与样本特定的潜在校正分离，仅需更新潜在状态即可利用稀疏观测实现复杂地形中快速、连续的高分辨率局地风场查询与校正。
en_tdlr: WindINR presents a latent-state implicit neural representation framework that decouples reusable representation learning from sample-specific latent correction, enabling fast, continuous high-resolution local wind query and correction in complex terrain by updating only the latent state with sparse observations.
